spans.s:
LECHEROUS: कामासक्तः (क्ता, क्तं): v. Lustful,
lewd.

LECTURE (subs.):
I Reading: *प्रपाठः।
II
A reproof: शासनम्।

LECTURE (v.):
I Of l.s: *प्रपठति (पठ्, c. 1.).
II To reprove: शास्ति (शास्, c. 2.).

LEECH:
I The reptile^1:
(1) रक्तपा;
(2) जलौकाः;
(3) जलोरगी। II. A physician: q. v.: मिषज्
(m.).
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210319. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/53.
